crop.notes: Only a fragment from the bottom of one column of 'Old and New Fighters' by Billy Edwards; the headline and the rest of the article are missing, the right edge clips the last letter of each line, and the sentence continues past the bottom.

ocr.notes: Matches the image except for letters clipped at the right edge.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch printed veteran Billy Edwards on old and new pugilism. He named Tom Allen with John Morrissey, Barney Aaron and Mike Donovan as old-school fighters known for great endurance.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Sunday, June 23, 1889. Article 'Old and New Fighters', written for the Sunday Post-Dispatch by Billy Edwards.

notes: Allen is named once, in a list of old-school fighters; no biographical facts.
